crossRefs.note: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
crossRefs.keyword: this is not to eat. or, ye cannot eat

translations.web: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
translations.bsb: Now then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat.
translations.kjv: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.
translations.asv: When therefore ye assemble yourselves together, it is not possible to eat the Lord's supper:
